principle_statement: Every set in this program is built around one constraint: the load never changes. Two 5kg dumbbells are the only external resistance available for all 12 weeks. Instead of adding weight, this program adds difficulty through five other levers: tempo (slower lowering phases and paused reps), density (less rest between sets), range of motion (deeper stretches, fuller contractions), unilateral loading (one limb at a time roughly doubles the relative load), and mechanical drop sets (switching to a weaker exercise variation the instant the primary one is fatigued). These five levers are what create progressive overload in this program.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Own the movement patterns. Every rep should be a rep you could show a coach without correction.
phases.technique_focus: Full range of motion on every rep. No mechanical drop sets yet. Learn the hip hinge, the squat pattern, and scapular control on rows before adding any intensity techniques.

phases.name: Tempo & Density
phases.goal: Make the same 5kg feel heavier by slowing down and resting less.
phases.tempo: 3-1-1-0 (3-second lowering phase, 1-second pause at the hardest point)
phases.technique_focus: Introduce single-arm and single-leg variations where listed (Single-Arm Row, Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift progression work). Begin using top-of-rep pauses on shoulder and back exercises.

phases.name: Advanced Overload
phases.goal: Push each set close to genuine muscular fatigue using every available tool.
phases.reps: 20-25, or mechanical drop sets to failure
phases.rest: 45-60 seconds (density phase — the clock is part of the overload)
phases.technique_focus: Full use of mechanical drop sets (e.g., Biceps Curl into Hammer Curl), unilateral primary lifts (Bulgarian Split Squat, Single-Arm Row as first-choice variations), and paused reps on every set.

phases.name: Capstone & Test
phases.goal: Measure exactly how far you have come and reset your baseline for the next 12-week cycle.
phases.sets: As programmed in the Week 12 test session
phases.reps: Maximum strict, controlled reps on benchmark exercises
phases.tempo: Standard controlled tempo, no forced slow-down — this week measures capacity, not time under tension
phases.rest: Full recovery between test attempts (2-3 minutes)
phases.technique_focus: Retest the four benchmark exercises from Week 1, retake measurements and photos, and log the results in the Progress Tracker before beginning a new cycle.

deload_protocol.sets: 2 per exercise (roughly 40% less volume than the surrounding weeks)
deload_protocol.note: A deload is not a rest day. You still train, but you leave every set feeling like you had 5+ reps left in the tank. This is what allows the joints and nervous system to catch up before the next phase increases difficulty again.

benchmark_tests.test: Maximum strict, full-range reps in one set
Maximum controlled reps at a 3-1-1-0 tempo before form breaks down
Maximum hold time with a perfectly straight line
Maximum strict reps with both 5kg dumbbells
